title.zh: 枪支、爆炸物与武器管制（宗教用途武器——类别许可）命令 2025
title.en: Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Religious Use of Weapons — Class Licence) Order 2025
title.orig: Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Religious Use of Weapons — Class Licence) Order 2025
title.vi: Lệnh Kiểm soát súng, chất nổ và vũ khí (Sử dụng vũ khí cho mục đích tôn giáo — Giấy phép theo nhóm) 2025
title.th: คำสั่งการควบคุมปืน วัตถุระเบิด และอาวุธ (การใช้อาวุธเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์ทางศาสนา — ใบอนุญาตประเภทกลุ่ม) 2025
title.id: Perintah Pengendalian Senjata Api, Bahan Peledak dan Senjata (Penggunaan Senjata untuk Keperluan Keagamaan — Izin Kelas) 2025
title.ms: Perintah Kawalan Senjata Api, Bahan Letupan dan Senjata (Penggunaan Senjata untuk Tujuan Keagamaan — Lesen Kelas) 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 10 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Religious Use of Weapons — Class Licence) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 July 2025.

3.—(1) This Order does not extend to an individual who is exempt by or under section 87 or 88 of the Act.
(2) The application of paragraph 4, 6 or 8 to an individual is subject to section 66(1) and (2)(c) of the Act.

4.—(1) Every individual who is required to wear or carry —
(a)a blunted kirpan so as to comply with the requirements of the practice in Singapore of his or her Sikh religion; or
(b)any other defined weapon so as to comply with the requirements of the practice in Singapore of his or her religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation,
is subject to a class licence authorising the individual to acquire and possess any blunted kirpan or other defined weapon (as the case may be), and to dispose of it, in connection with that practice of his or her religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation.
(2) To avoid doubt, paragraph (1) extends to a passenger, crew member and the master of —
(a)a defined ship who leaves Singapore on a voyage on board the same defined ship in which he or she entered Singapore; or
(b)a ship leaving Singapore on or after 1 July 2025 on board a ship on a voyage, if the passenger, crew member or master entered Singapore on the same ship not earlier than the 30th day before 1 July 2025,
when the passenger, crew member or master (as the case may be) is in Singapore.
(3) In sub‑paragraph (2), “crew member”, “defined ship”, “master”, “passenger” and “voyage” have the meanings given by the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Maritime Industry — Exemption) Order 2025 (G.N. No. S 373/2025).

heading.en: Conditions of religious practitioner’s class licence

chapter.en: PART 3 FUNERARY RITES AND RELIGIOUS SERVICES

heading.en: Class licence for conducting funeral event or religious service, etc.

text.en:
6. Every individual who is required to wear or carry or similarly possess a defined weapon —
(a)in the course of the individual conducting —
(i)a funeral event or funerary memorial event organised according to any religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation; or
(ii)a religious service; and
(b)so as to comply with the requirements of the practice in Singapore of the Sikh religion in the case of a defined weapon that is a kirpan, or of any other religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation in the case of any other defined weapon,
is subject to a class licence authorising the individual to acquire and possess the kirpan or other defined weapon in connection with the individual conducting that funeral event, funerary memorial event or religious service, and to dispose of it during or at the end of that funeral event, funerary memorial event or religious service (as the case may be) if required.

chapter.en: PART 3 FUNERARY RITES AND RELIGIOUS SERVICES

heading.en: Conditions of class licence to conduct funeral event or religious service, etc.

chapter.en: PART 3 FUNERARY RITES AND RELIGIOUS SERVICES

heading.en: Class licence for taking part in funeral event, etc.

text.en:
8. Every individual who is required to carry a defined weapon —
(a)in the course of taking part in a funeral event or funerary memorial event organised according to any religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation; and
(b)so as to comply with the requirements of the practice in Singapore —
(i)of the Sikh religion in the case of a defined weapon that is a kirpan; or
(ii)of any other religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation in the case of any other defined weapon,
is subject to a class licence authorising the individual to possess the kirpan or other defined weapon in connection with the individual taking part in that funeral event or funerary memorial event.

chapter.en: PART 3 FUNERARY RITES AND RELIGIOUS SERVICES

heading.en: Conditions of class licence for taking part in funeral event, etc.

text.en:
9. A class licensee by virtue of paragraph 8 with respect to taking part in a funeral event or funerary memorial event may possess a defined weapon subject to all the following conditions:
(a)the class licensee carries the defined weapon only —
(i)during the period he or she is taking part in the funeral event or funerary memorial event, and at the location of the funeral event or funerary memorial event;
(ii)according to the requirements of the practice in Singapore —
(A)of the Sikh religion in the case of a defined weapon that is a kirpan; or
(B)of any other religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation in the case of any other defined weapon; and
(iii)while under the supervision and control of a class licensee by virtue of paragraph 6 who is conducting the funeral event or funerary memorial event;
(b)the class licensee does not leave the defined weapon unattended.

chapter.en: PART 3 FUNERARY RITES AND RELIGIOUS SERVICES

heading.en: Personal religious belief not material for paragraph 8

text.en:
10. To avoid doubt, for the purposes of paragraph 8, it does not matter that —
(a)the individual’s religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation is not the same as that applied at the funeral event, funerary memorial event or religious service; or
(b)the individual does not have any religious belief, religious opinion or religious affiliation.
